partnership_announcements.description: SQUATWOLF has established its 'Support Homegrown' programme as an ongoing partnership platform with 20 emerging UAE wellness and lifestyle brands, providing digital amplification, community events, and retail space in its Dubai stores to elevate these partners’ visibility and sales.

partnership_announcements.description: SQUATWOLF has partnered with Kuwaiti retail group Ali Abdulwahab Al Mutawa Commercial Co. (AAW) to build and operate its standalone flagship and broader retail presence in Kuwait.

overview_description.description: Squatwolf is an activewear and fitness apparel company that develops and sells gym wear, workout clothing, and fitness accessories for men and women through e-commerce platforms and selected retail locations. Its product range includes training t-shirts, leggings, shorts, hoodies, joggers, sports bras, bags, socks, and other athletic accessories.

about_short_description.short_description: Squatwolf is an online store that sells jackets, hoodies, shorts, jogger pants, leggings, t-shirts, tank tops, sports bras, and accessories.

product.name: Men's Gym Wear
product.description: Workout clothing for men, including T-shirts, tanks, stringers, shorts, joggers, pants, jackets, hoodies, tights, and underwear.

product.name: Women's Workout Clothes
product.description: Women's activewear including T-shirts, crop tops, tank tops, sports bras, leggings, shorts, joggers, wide-leg pants, jackets, and hoodies.

product.name: T-Shirts and Training Tops
product.description: Short- and long-sleeve T-shirts, mesh shirts, crop T-shirts, tanks, stringers, and quarter-zip tops for training and casual wear.

product.name: Shorts
product.description: Training, running, split, and 2-in-1 shorts in different lengths for gym workouts and activewear use.

product.name: Leggings and Tights
product.description: Women's leggings and men's tights for training, running, studio exercise, and other activewear applications.

product.name: Hoodies, Jackets, and Joggers
product.description: Layering and casual-performance apparel including hoodies, track jackets, hybrid jackets, track pants, joggers, and wide-leg pants.
